units.source_text: 从这时候起，我关心肉体忽然有甚于关心精神。

en.t: From this time on, my concern for the body suddenly became greater than my concern for the spirit.

units.source_text: 但是，自己不能化身为纯粹的欲望，只是梦幻而已。

en.t: But to transform oneself into pure desire was only a dream, and could not be done.

units.source_text: 仿佛成了一阵风，成了从对面也看不见的存在，

en.t: It was as if I had become a gust of wind, an existence invisible even from the opposite side,

units.source_text: 而从这面则看到一切，并轻而易举地靠近对象，

en.t: while from this side I could see everything and approach the object with effortless ease,

units.source_text: 全身抚爱对象，最终悄然潜入其内部……

en.t: caressing the object with my whole body, and finally slipping silently inside it...

units.source_text: 当肉体觉醒的时候，你可能会想像到一种具有一定质量的、不透明的、坚定的"东西"在觉醒。

en.t: When the body awakens, you may imagine that some opaque, solid "thing" with a certain mass is awakening.
But I was not like that.

units.source_text: 一个肉体、一个欲望的完成，就是我成了透明的。

en.t: The completion of one body, of one desire, meant that I had become transparent.

units.source_text: 看不见的东西，也就是成了风。

en.t: I had become something invisible; in other words, I had become the wind.
